'''Lint filters''' were components of machinery that captured lint and other small debris. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] one suggested that the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] [[Security Police/Legends|Security Police]] recycled criminal [[Droid/Legends|droids]] into lint filters and [[spittoon]]s.
